why: Chat UI ships as copy-in prose today: `docs/recipes/chat-thread.md` (a `Thread` owning `Chat` in state), `chat-thread-composer.md` (a `MessageBox`: Textarea and Button, Enter sends, IME-safe, text restored on failure), `chat-thread-scroll.md`, `ai-approvals-sources.md` (reasoning in a `Collapsible`). What ships in basalt-ui/ai is `partView` (src/ai/part-view.tsx; reasoning, file, source and data parts fall back to one line), `defineBlock` and `defineCatalog`, and the types `MessagePart`, `ToolView`, `PartViewOptions` (src/ai/contract.ts). The composer is also the mail composer of bench-inbox-mail. docs/v3/DIRECTION.md section 6 refused "chat UI parts" until a named consumer; the owner approved the benchmark that adds them (README), and this row reverses that line.
what: Composer, reasoning trace, message actions, model picker and mentions as parts on basalt-ui/ai, with no runtime.

change: Read first: docs/v3/issues/bench/README.md (owner direction, decisions, how to use the reference) and docs/v3/BENCHMARK-ACCORDEE-BLUEPRINT.md, sections 2 and 11. Decided: (1) `Composer`: a textarea that grows to a cap and then scrolls, Enter sends and Shift+Enter breaks (IME-safe, as `MessageBox`), the text comes back when a send fails, a footer with slots for an add menu, mentions, a model picker and a status-driven send or stop button (`status` and `stop` passed in from the app's `useChat`), attachments through `FileUpload` (basalt-ui/ui/file-upload). Plain text, no rich-text editor. It is chat-agnostic: bench-inbox-mail reuses it for mail. (2) Mentions: typing `@` opens the list engine's grouped, async Combobox popover anchored at the caret; picking inserts a typed token that the composer returns as data beside the text, never only a literal `@`. (3) `ModelPicker`: a grouped single or multi select on the list engine with a count footer. (4) `ReasoningTrace`: reasoning text and tool steps as one collapsed line ("N tools used") that expands to an ordered rail; `partView` renders the reasoning part with it instead of the fallback; motion respects reduced motion. (5) `MessageActions`: copy, regenerate, feedback, edit, as typed actions (data, like PageBar actions), shown on hover and focus with a keyboard path, at the icon button size. (6) User messages take a bubble capped in width, assistant text takes none. (7) The thread page itself is a block, not a part (bench-blocks); here a playground route proves the parts in an assistant over the parts inventory. The proof page sits on the parts-inventory domain of the reference pages (apps/playground/src/routes/ref/, its fixtures and fixed today) and compiles on the playground's app lint preset with zero basalt waivers; if packages/basalt-ui/blocks/ exists when you start (bench-blocks landed), ship the page as a block instead of a route.
